scope.description: Synchronous three-instance Raft test-network read-context probe with no dropped messages and no crashes.
assumptions: Initial voter membership is supplied by the existing newNetwork(nil,nil,nil) test constructor.
The existing test transport simulates completion of append dependencies without persisting durable bytes; the probe makes no crash-recovery claim.
Single-threaded ownership provides coherent observations of internal readStates, term, commit and pending queue.

basis.prefix: Create three new Raft instances with the existing test constructor and empty logs; deliver a local campaign and all resulting actual election/append messages. Require leader state and a committed current-term entry before issuing the first read. Deliver all messages without filtering. Observe output in sequence independently of returned context. Send three local heartbeat triggers with full delivery, then a second unique nonempty read request. Repeat the same schedule in an independent network with a nonempty initial context.
